Messages.Author: YY
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ,

If Azreal hunts successfully at full blood and then tries to use his
ability, what happens?

a) The excess blood slides off and the other vampire gains nothing, or
b) The excess blood slides off and Azreal moves one of his blood to
the other vampire (leaving Azreal at 4 blood), or
c) The excess blood is moved to the other vampire before it slides off
Azreal (leaving Azreal with 5 blood)

- YY

Azrael [HttB:U]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Salubri antitribu
Group: 6
Capacity: 5
Discipline: for AUS VAL
Sabbat: When Azrael hunts, he may move one of the blood he would gain
to another vampire you control. He cannot press to end combat.

and Voter Cap?
